share.sheet.title: Ask TensorAgent
share.sheet.defaultQuestion: What can you tell me about this?
share.preset.summarize.label: Summarize
share.preset.summarize.prompt: Summarize this and tell me what matters in it.
share.preset.explain.label: Explain
share.preset.keyPoints.label: Key points
share.preset.keyPoints.prompt: Pull out the key points as a short list.
share.preset.actionItems.label: Action items
share.preset.actionItems.prompt: What, if anything, do I need to do about this? Be specific.
share.preset.translate.label: Translate
share.preset.translate.prompt: Translate this into English. If it is already English, translate it into Chinese.
share.error.inboxFull: TensorAgent's sharing inbox is full. Open TensorAgent to import the waiting items, then try again.
share.error.saveFailed: The item could not be saved. Please keep this sheet open and try again.
share.saved.title: Saved to TensorAgent
share.saved.notified: Tap the TensorAgent notification to continue in chat.
share.saved.openApp: Open TensorAgent to continue. iOS does not allow a Share extension to switch apps automatically.
share.notification.title: Shared item ready
share.notification.body: Tap to open TensorAgent and continue in chat.
share.message.prompt.page: Summarize this page and tell me what matters in it.
share.message.prompt.text: Summarize this and tell me what matters in it.
share.message.prompt.link: I shared a link. You cannot open pages, so tell me what the address and title suggest, and ask me to paste the text if you need it.
share.message.prompt.file: Take a look at this file and tell me what is in it.
share.message.prompt.files: Take a look at these files and tell me what is in them.
share.message.prompt.anything: Take a look at what I shared and tell me what matters in it.
